_comment: Bokhylle / shelf – the source of truth for what exists. play.js reads this instead of guessing filenames, which would log a 404 per missing combination.
_title: title = custom shelf title, most specific wins: {lg:{ed:'…'}} > {lg:'…'} > '…'. Lookup never crosses languages (NO/EN differ, and PREM/FREE may too). Omit → the open file's own H1, else the folder name.
_titleShape: { "NO": { "PREM": "Liv krevde død – Premium", "FREE": "Liv krevde død" }, "EN": "Life demanded Death" }  ·  flat "NO_PREM" keys also work
_editions: lg × ed must exist as b/<book>/b_<lg>_<ed>.md . A book that only has a PDF omits lg/ed and sets pdf instead.
